envelope.result: JSON string: a list of result objects, always at least one object_type='message' targeting the response

classifier_precedence: 'not found' in message OR FileNotFoundError -> resource_not_found

resource_not_found.result: [{"object_type": "message", "result_target": "response", "result_encoding": "plain", "data": "Generate_wiki failed for model 'gpt-4o': Wiki not found for repository"}]

service_busy.result: [{"object_type": "message", "result_target": "response", "result_encoding": "plain", "data": "Generate_wiki failed for model 'gpt-4o': [SERVICE_BUSY] DeepWiki service is busy"}]

artifact_error.result: [{"object_type": "message", "result_target": "response", "result_encoding": "plain", "data": "Generate_wiki failed for model 'gpt-4o': Failed to download artifact"}]

out_of_memory.result: [{"object_type": "message", "result_target": "response", "result_encoding": "plain", "data": "Generate_wiki failed for model 'gpt-4o': out of memory while embedding"}]

timeout_error.result: [{"object_type": "message", "result_target": "response", "result_encoding": "plain", "data": "Generate_wiki failed for model 'gpt-4o': Clone timeout after 300s"}]

inference_failed.result: [{"object_type": "message", "result_target": "response", "result_encoding": "plain", "data": "Generate_wiki failed for model 'gpt-4o': LLM generation failed"}]

runtime_error.result: [{"object_type": "message", "result_target": "response", "result_encoding": "plain", "data": "Generate_wiki failed for model 'gpt-4o': worker exited with code 1"}]

invalid_input.result: [{"object_type": "message", "result_target": "response", "result_encoding": "plain", "data": "Generate_wiki failed for model 'gpt-4o': query must not be empty"}]

route_level.note: emitted by methods/invocations.py when the task result cannot be read, and by routes/invoke.py when the task cannot be started

notes: A failed tool is HTTP 200 with status='Error' in the body — the errorCode/message/details envelope is only used for transport-level failures. Both shapes must survive the port.

include_traceback=True (unknown toolkit/tool, unhandled exception) puts a full Python stack trace into a user-facing message. The port should keep the category/type fields and stop shipping the trace outward.
